resources.string: Speech to text
Recognized text only goes into your draft and is never sent automatically. The app does not save, upload, or forward audio. The microphone turns on only after you start recognition.
Speech recognition runs on this device and will not automatically switch to an online service.

On-device speech recognition is unavailable. The system speech service may send audio to its provider for online processing. Preferring offline recognition does not guarantee it, and the app does not control this.
Allow the system speech service this time
No system speech service is available. You can still type.
Waiting for the result… Leaving the app cancels recognition immediately.
Listening… Leaving the app cancels recognition immediately.
Waiting for the microphone permission request. Recognition will not start if you close this dialog or leave the app.
Recognized text (editable)
Stop listening
Start recognition

Microphone permission was not granted. Recognition did not start. You can manage permissions in system settings.

No speech recognition service is available. You can still type.
Microphone permission is required. You can revoke it in system settings.
